# branded-mail

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

Every notification renders through the configured mail composer's branded layout, with the header, footer and preheader set once; no per-mail Blade copies.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make notification --flavor=plain <Name>`.

Kit: none.
Checks: mail. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "What does the mail carry?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=mail-notifications.branded-layout` to see its siblings.
